---
format:
  typst:
    output-file: Barbone-Resume.pdf
    papersize: us-letter
    margin: 
      x: "0.75in"
      y: "0.75in"
    footer: false
    numbering: false
    keep-typ: false
    template-partials:
      - resume/typst-template.typ
execute:
  echo: false 
params:
  metadata_file: _metadata.yaml
  bib_packages: bib/packages.bib
---

```{r}
#| label: fn
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)

experience_item <- function(item) {
  bullets <- bullet_items_condensed(
    item$highlights,
    item$accomplishments,
    max_bullets = 3
  )

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    org: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_org(item))),
    sprintf("    location: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_location(item))),
    sprintf("    role: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_role(item))),
    sprintf("    dates: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_dates(item))),
    "    bullets: ("
  )

  for (b in bullets) {
    out <- c(out, sprintf("      %s,", to_typst_content(b)))
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

education_item <- function(item) {
  c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    org: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_org(item))),
    sprintf("    credential: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_credential(item))),
    sprintf("    location: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_location(item))),
    sprintf("    dates: %s,", to_typst_content(entry_dates(item))),
    "  ),"
  )
}

skills_item <- function(name, details) {
  c(
    "  (",
    sprintf("    name: %s,", to_typst_content(name)),
    sprintf("    details: %s,", to_typst_content(details)),
    "  ),"
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data
meta <- yaml::read_yaml(params$metadata_file)
experience <- meta$experience
education <- meta$education
skills <- meta$skills
package_links <- read_package_links(params$bib_packages)
experience <- sort_experience(experience)
experience <- head(experience, 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep
scalar_lines <- c(
  "// Auto-generated from YAML sources. Do not edit manually.",
  sprintf("#let cv_given = %s", typst_string(meta$given)),
  sprintf("#let cv_surname = %s", typst_string(meta$surname)),
  sprintf("#let cv_location = %s", typst_string(meta$location)),
  sprintf("#let cv_phone = %s", typst_string(meta$phone)),
  sprintf("#let cv_email = %s", typst_string(meta$email)),
  sprintf("#let cv_web = %s", typst_string(meta$web)),
  sprintf("#let cv_github = %s", typst_string(meta$github)),
  sprintf("#let cv_linkedin = %s", typst_string(meta$linkedin))
)

experience_lines <- c("#let experience_data = (")

for (item in experience) {
  experience_lines <- c(experience_lines, experience_item(item))
}
experience_lines <- c(experience_lines, ")")

education_lines <- c("#let education_data = (")

for (i in seq_along(education)) {
  item <- education[[i]]
  if (startsWith(entry_credential(item), "Non")) {
    next
  }
  education_lines <- c(education_lines, education_item(item))
}
education_lines <- c(education_lines, ")")

skills_lines <- c("#let skills_data = (")
for (s in skills) {
  skills_lines <- c(skills_lines, skills_item(s$name, s$details))
}
skills_lines <- c(skills_lines, ")")

packages_lines <- c("#let packages_data = (")
for (pkg in package_links) {
  packages_lines <- c(
    packages_lines,
    "  (",
    sprintf("    name: %s,", to_typst_content(pkg$name)),
    sprintf("    url: %s,", typst_string(pkg$url)),
    "  ),"
  )
}
packages_lines <- c(packages_lines, ")")
```

```{=typst}
#import "resume/typst-template.typ": *
```

```{r}
#| label: out_scalars
#| results: asis
emit_typst_chunk(scalar_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: out_experience
#| results: asis
emit_typst_chunk(experience_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: out_education
#| results: asis
emit_typst_chunk(education_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: out_skills
#| results: asis
emit_typst_chunk(skills_lines)
```

```{r}
#| label: out_packages
#| results: asis
emit_typst_chunk(packages_lines)
```
